quote: (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C))
rationale: The married names exception is governed by external reference 8 FAM 403.1-4(C) and is fully incorporated into the scope, summary, and references of grouped requirement C0000.
The regulatory reference 22 CFR 51.25 is retained in the context quotes and references list of C0000.
Documentation of customary usage is an acceptable documentation alternative rather than a condition or exception; it cannot be addressed during the relationship pass.
